home.introTitle: Care that feels considered, not clinical
home.introBody: Body Signature was created around a simple idea: that health, beauty, and wellbeing are personal, and deserve to be treated with care, patience, and craft. Every service is guided by attentive consultation and a calm, respectful environment.
home.servicesTitle: Five ways we care for you
home.servicesSubtitle: From medical guidance to beauty rituals, each category is built around a distinct expertise.
home.newArrivalsSubtitle: The latest additions to our shop, curated by Body Signature.
home.ctaBody: Tell us a little about what you're looking for, and we'll help you find the right path.

about.title: Our story, our approach
introPoints: Body Signature brings medical expertise, herbal knowledge, alternative therapies, and modern beauty together under one calm, considered roof.
We believe wellbeing is personal — so our approach starts with listening, not prescribing.
Every step, from the first conversation onward, moves at an unhurried, attentive pace.
We stay involved as your needs change, rather than treating any visit as a one-off.

pillars.title: Personal, not generic
pillars.body: Every visit begins with a real conversation about your goals, so recommendations are tailored to you, not a one-size-fits-all routine.

pillars.title: Considered environment
pillars.body: From the first consultation to aftercare, the space and pace are designed to feel calm, private, and unhurried.

pillars.title: Breadth of expertise
pillars.body: Medical, herbal, alternative, and beauty specialties sit side by side, so your care can draw on more than one discipline.

medical-healthcare.title: Medical & Healthcare
medical-healthcare.summary: Attentive, professional medical guidance for everyday health.
medical-healthcare.description: Our medical and healthcare services are grounded in careful consultation and a respectful, professional environment. We take the time to understand your health goals before recommending a path forward, and we stay involved as your needs evolve.

herbal-medicine.title: Herbal Medicine
herbal-medicine.description: Herbal medicine draws on a long tradition of botanical care. Our approach pairs that knowledge with careful listening, so any recommendation reflects your individual constitution and needs rather than a generic formula.
features: Consultation on herbal traditions and options
Guidance on integrating herbal care into daily life

alternative-medicine.title: Alternative Medicine
alternative-medicine.summary: Complementary therapies for balance and wellbeing.
alternative-medicine.description: Our alternative medicine offering explores complementary approaches to wellbeing, always in an open conversation about what you're hoping to achieve. We favor a measured, honest approach over bold promises.
features: Care coordinated around your broader wellbeing

beauty.title: Beauty for Women & Men
beauty.summary: Modern beauty rituals for every client.
beauty.description: Our beauty services are designed for women and men alike, blending contemporary technique with an unhurried, personal touch. Every treatment begins with a conversation about what you'd like to feel and see.
features: Treatments tailored to skin, style, and goals
Guidance on at-home care between visits

training-courses.title: Training Courses
training-courses.summary: Professional training for practitioners and enthusiasts.
training-courses.description: Our training courses share practical, professional knowledge across our specialties. Whether you're building a career or deepening your own practice, sessions are structured, hands-on, and led by experienced practitioners.
features: Guidance suited to your experience level

facial-treatments-women.title: Facial Treatments
facial-treatments-women.summary: Deep-cleansing and rejuvenating facials tailored to your skin.
facial-treatments-women.description: Our facial treatments combine gentle deep-cleansing, exfoliation, and hydration to leave your skin refreshed and balanced. Each session begins with a short skin assessment, so the treatment responds to what your skin needs that day.
features: Personalized skin assessment before every session

laser-hair-removal-women.title: Laser Hair Removal
laser-hair-removal-women.summary: Smooth, long-lasting hair reduction with modern laser technology.
laser-hair-removal-women.description: Our laser hair removal treatments use modern technology to deliver smooth, long-lasting results with minimal discomfort. Sessions are scheduled around your skin and hair type, with a clear plan from consultation through aftercare.
features: Consultation to match technology to your skin and hair type

peeling-skin-renewal-women.title: Peeling & Skin Renewal
peeling-skin-renewal-women.summary: Gentle exfoliating treatments that renew and brighten skin.
peeling-skin-renewal-women.description: Our peeling treatments gently exfoliate the skin's surface to reveal a fresher, more even tone underneath. We select the right strength and formula for your skin, so renewal happens without unnecessary irritation.
features: Peeling strength matched to your skin's sensitivity
Focus on tone, texture, and radiance
Aftercare guidance to protect newly renewed skin

skin-brightening-women.title: Skin Whitening & Brightening
skin-brightening-women.summary: Treatments that even tone and restore a natural glow.
skin-brightening-women.description: Our skin brightening treatments target uneven tone and dullness, helping restore a natural, healthy-looking glow. Every plan is built around your skin's history and goals, with realistic expectations set from the start.
features: Assessment of skin tone and history before treatment
Guidance on maintaining results at home

beauty-grooming-women.title: Beauty & Grooming
beauty-grooming-women.summary: Everyday beauty rituals, from grooming to finishing touches.
beauty-grooming-women.description: From grooming essentials to finishing touches, our beauty services cover the everyday rituals that help you feel put-together. Each visit is unhurried, with attention to detail throughout.
features: A range of everyday grooming and beauty services

laser-hair-removal-men.title: Laser Hair Removal
laser-hair-removal-men.summary: Effective, long-lasting hair reduction designed for men's skin and hair.
laser-hair-removal-men.description: Our laser hair removal for men is calibrated for typically coarser hair and skin, delivering effective, long-lasting reduction with a straightforward, no-fuss process from consultation to aftercare.
features: Technology calibrated for coarser hair types

facial-cleansing-men.title: Facial Cleansing
facial-cleansing-men.summary: Straightforward deep-cleansing treatments for men's skin.
facial-cleansing-men.description: Our facial cleansing treatments for men focus on deep-cleansing pores, managing oil, and calming irritation from daily shaving or grooming, in a quick, no-nonsense session.

skin-care-men.title: Skin Care & Anti-Aging
skin-care-men.summary: Practical skin care and anti-aging treatments for men.
skin-care-men.description: Our skin care treatments for men address everyday concerns like fine lines, dullness, and uneven texture with a practical, low-fuss approach and clear guidance you can follow at home.
features: Focus on fine lines, dullness, and texture

grooming-men.title: Grooming & Wellness
grooming-men.summary: Grooming services that round out a complete self-care routine.
grooming-men.description: From grooming essentials to relaxing finishing touches, our services for men round out a complete self-care routine in a calm, private setting.
features: A range of grooming and wellness services
Sessions suited to a busy schedule
